content.title: NFL Draft 2026 - FAQ
content.text: 2026 NFL DRAFT PRESENTED BY BUD LIGHT | FAQ'sBy clicking below, you can navigate directly to items included within each category: 1. General Information 2. NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express 3. NFL Draft Theater & Main Stage 4. NFL OnePass 5. Security Protocols 6. Family FAQ 7. Accessibility Information 8. Pittsburgh Travel General InformationHow do I access the 2026 NFL Draft in Pittsburgh April 23-25?The 2026 NFL Draft is comprised of the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express, which is FREE for all ages, and the Draft Theater for invited ticket holders. For free entry to the Draft Experience, fans are required to register for their NFL OnePass QR code at NFL.com/draftaccess. All adults 18 or older would have to register individually, adults can register up to 5 minors and they would all use the same QR code. For the Draft Theater, seating is only available to invited ticket holders, however, as seats become available, fans will have an opportunity to be selected for standing room and other seating depending upon availability, usually for Friday and Saturday only. More information about the backfill fan seating for the Draft Theater to come soon. Download the NFL OnePass app to access all the most up to date details, including player and legend autograph appearance schedules, maps and transportation information, FAQs and other important information to enhance your Draft experience. Visit NFL.com/onepass to download.When will the 2026 NFL Draft be held?The 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light will take place Thursday, April 23through Saturday, April 25, 2026Draft Experience Hours:April 23: 12pm—10pm ETApril 24: 12pm—10pm ETApril 25: 9am—6pm ETDraft Theater Hours:April 23: 5pm—11pm ET (approximate)April 24: 5pm—11pm ET (approximate)April 25: 12pm—7pm ET (approximate)Where is the 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light located?The 2026 NFL Draft will take place in Pittsburgh Pennsylvania in the lots surrounding Acrisure Stadium and Point State Park.How do I access both Point State Park and Acrisure Stadium?There will be fan entries at both locations and a fan map showing these entries will be published by April 10, 2026. For fans moving between both sites, you will utilize the Roberto Clemente Bridge. The pedestrian bridge will not be utilized for this event due to public safety concerns with anticipated crowd size. There will be ADA mobility assistance available and an ADA accessibility guide will be published by April 10, 2026.How can I watch the 2026 NFL Draft on television?The 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light will be televised nationally by NFL Network, ABC, ESPN and ESPN Deportes.On-air coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light will begin at the times listed below:April 23 (Thursday): 8 PM ET /7 PM CT – NFL Network, ABC, ESPN, ESPN Deportes (Spanish)April 24 (Friday): 7 PM ET / 6 PM CT – NFL Network, ABC, ESPN, ESPN Deportes (Spanish)April 25 (Saturday): Noon ET / 11 AM CT – NFL Network, ABC, ESPN, ESPN Deportes (Spanish)For more information on NFL Network's Draft Week Coverage, visit https://www.nfl.com/draft.What is the schedule of activities?Please download the NFL OnePass app at nfl.com/onepass for information on the timing and location of events.Are there VIP packages for purchase?Yes, NFL On Location is our partner and their Draft packages are available NOW below. All remaining fans with NFL OnePass QR code for FREE entry would have GENERAL ADMISSION access (no seats inside the Draft Theater):How can I get to the 2026 NFL Draft?For the 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light in Pittsburgh, fan parking will resemble game day at Acrisure Stadium.Are there concerts or performances going on during the NFL Draft?Yes, more information regarding the FREE concerts will be released in the coming weeks prior to Day 1 of the NFL DraftVisit NFL.com/OnePass for your free entry to the NFL Draft Concert Series presented by Bud Light.NFL DRAFT EXPERIENCE presented by American ExpressWill I have a view of the Draft Theater within Draft Experience? Will I have a seat in the Theater?Because the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express and Draft Theater are situated adjacent to one another, fans attending Draft Experience will have sightlines to the Draft Theater to watch every pick of the Draft and concerts if they are on the North Shore side of the Draft Experience. There will be screens throughout Draft Experience in both the North Shore campus and Point State Park as well as space to view the Theater stage accessible on a first come, first serve basis.Fans will have a standing room only view of the Theater, not a seat within the Theater. Tickets for the Theater are reserved for prospects friends & family, partners and NFL club guests. Draft Experience attractions will also be running simultaneously with the Draft.What is NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express is a FREE, family-friendly football festival celebrating the 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light, held in the parking lots outside Acrisure Stadium and Point State Park, from Thursday, April 23 - Saturday, April 25. Fans of all ages will be able to participate in interactive games, take photos at exhibits including The Vince Lombardi Trophy, free player autograph sessions, and more! Check out a map of the event and full list of attractions in the NFL OnePass app.Do I need tickets for the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?No, you just need your OnePass QR code to participate. All events are FREE and open to the public. Fans will be required to present proof of registration with NFL OnePass online by registering starting on March 4, 2026 at http://nfl.com/DraftAccess or via our NFL OnePass mobile app for entry to the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express and Draft Theater. With the Theater situated adjacent to Draft Experience, viewing will be available of the stage itself and on multiple screens throughout the event site.What are the entry requirements?All fans will go through airport level screening for entry and must adhere to our prohibited items list. The **NFL Clear Bag Policy** will be in effect for the NFL Draft. Fans are also required to register for NFL OnePass at nfl.com/draftaccess or by downloading the NFL OnePass app starting on March 4, 2026.What is prohibited at NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?The NFL Draft, including NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express and the Draft Theater, is a smoke-free environment. The use of tobacco products and e-cigarettes is prohibited. For a complete list of Prohibited Items at NFL Draft, please see HERE.Security screening in and around the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express will be significantly heightened. All items carried by fans will be carefully inspected and potentially prohibited from entry. The NFL All Clear policy will be in effect.Note: Prohibited items and items determined to be inappropriate for entry into the secure perimeter will be the responsibility of the fan and cannot be accepted, stored or checked by the NFL or the Pittsburgh Police Department.Fans are strongly encouraged to refrain from bringing any type of bag to the 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light to expedite their entryWhat is permitted at NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?Clear Bag Policy:Clear Bags no larger than 12" x 6" x 12". (*NFL Clear Bag Policy* will be in effect)Small purses/clutch bags will be carried through screeningSize exceptions will be made for medically necessary itemsStrollers and baby carriages will be permitted, subject to screeningStrollers - Strollers and baby carriages are permitted, however all bags and blankets must be removed and screened by x-ray and will be physically/visually inspected.Cameras – Small cameras and binoculars will be permitted. Professional grade camera and recording equipment will only be permitted for properly Draft Credentialed mediaReusable Water Bottles – Fans will be allowed to enter with an empty, reusable water bottle for free water filling when inside the perimeter.SECURITY SCREENING BEGINS AT THE FOLLOWING TIMES AT NFL DRAFT EXPERIENCE presented by American Express ENTRANCES:THURSDAY, APRIL 23 – 12PMFRIDAY, APRIL 24 – 12PMSATURDAY, APRIL 25 – 9AMDoes the Draft Experience accept cash at concessions or NFL Shop?The Draft Experience is a cash free event. However, all major credit cards are accepted. All concessions on site as well as the NFL Shop will only accept credit cards. The NFL's official payments partner is American Express.Do I have to pay to participate in the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express is FREE to the public and does not require a ticket, however, each fan must register with NFL OnePass, either by downloading the NFL OnePass App in the app store or by visiting nfl.com/draftaccess, to enter on a first come, first serve basis. All purchases made at NFL Shop presented by American Express and at concessions are cash-free.When does the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express open?NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express is open on the below dates and times (ET):April 23: 12pm—10pm ETApril 24: 12pm—10pm ETApril 5: 9am—6pm ETIs there a public wifi network?Yes, the public wifi network is:What is the schedule of activities?The activities do not change daily except for the player appearance schedule, the attractions will remain open for all hours of operation. The Draft selection show will begin at the Draft Theater at 8pm ET on Thursday, 7pm ET on Friday and 12PM ET on Saturday. NFL OnePass is not accepted as entry into the seated Draft Theater.What NFL players will be signing autographs at the Draft Experience?The player appearance schedule will be updated by April 14 in the NFL OnePass app exclusively and will continue to refresh with new appearances over the course of the 3 days of the Draft. Player appearances are subject to change without notice.Are there age limits on any of the activities at NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?Yes, the football clinics conducted on the NFL Play Football Field on the field at Acrisure Stadium open to kids ages 6–14 only. The other various passing, running, kicking and receiving games and attractions are for fans of all ages once the adult has registered for NFL OnePass (including minors).Can I bring in outside food or beverages?Outside food or beverages are not permitted inside the NFL Draft campus. Food and beverage will be available for purchase within the concession areas around the Draft site. For fans with medical dietary restrictions, outside food is admissible.What is the plan in the case of bad weather?NFL events are commonly held in inclement weather. Only in the case of extreme weather that threatens public safety will the event potentially be postponed. In the unlikely event that such a situation occurs, information for fans will be available on NFL.com/Draft-event-info, pushed out via the NFL OnePass app and announced over the PA system on-site.How many people will be allowed to attend the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?While there is no set capacity for the event, fans who have registered for OnePass will be admitted to the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express on a first come first serve basis, and security will closely monitor capacity to ensure the safety of all attendees.Can I speak to a customer service representative?We will have customer service representatives available via email at Experience.Support@NFL.comNFL DRAFT THEATERWhat is the Draft Theater?All three days of the 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light will take place at the Draft Theater, located in the parking lot in front of the existing Steelers Pro Shop at Art Rooney Ave. Commissioner Goodell and other special guests will be announcing the player selections of each of the 32 NFL teams.What is the Draft Theater? How do I get tickets?The Draft Theater is where prospects will be selected to their new teams, additionally the Draft concert series will take place on the stage after the selections end on Days 2 and 3. Seating within the Theater is available only to invited ticket holders, however, as seats become available, fans will have an opportunity to be selected for standing room and other seating depending upon availability. The NFL OnePass QR code is not a ticket to the Draft Theater.What is the Inner Circle? How do I get tickets?The Inner Circle is where select fans are invited by the 32 teams to view the Draft Stage from within the Theater. Tickets for these sections are exclusively distributed by the 32 clubs.If I'm in Draft Experience, can I go to the Draft Theater?Yes! Because the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express and Draft Theater are located adjacent to one another, fans will have the ability to flow freely between the two areas. However, fans may only access the standing room / Theater Viewing area as tickets are needed to access the Draft Theater seated area.Note: Once ticketholders exit the Draft Theater, there is no re-entry.How do I access my ticket to the NFL Draft Theater?Fans who have a ticket to attend the NFL Draft presented by Bud Light within the Draft Theater will need to download the NFL OnePass App in order to access their mobile ticket and receive key "Know Before You Go" information. The NFL OnePass App can be downloaded for Android (LINK) OR iOS (LINK) device.If I am coming from NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express, will I be required to go through security screening again to enter the Draft Theater?No. Fans will not be required to be screened for a second time to enter the Draft Theater after going through screening to enter NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express, as long as they do NOT exit the secure fenced perimeter. However, they will be required to have their Draft Theater ticket scanned, upon arrival to the Draft Theater.Will there be concessions within the Draft Theater?Yes. Food and beverage items will be available for purchase inside the Draft Theater.NFL OnePassWhat is NFL OnePass and is it required to enter NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?NFL OnePass is your digital access pass to the Draft and provides fans with up to the minute schedules including the Player and Legends autograph schedule, and other information for making the most out of attending NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express. Fans can download the app in the App Store or on Google Play. Alternatively, fans can register on www.nfl.com/draftaccess to receive their QR code. Registration is FREE for NFL OnePass – no purchase necessary. Registration opens on MARCH 4.OnePass is required to enter NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express and gives fans the ability to:Access exclusive event information, player and Legend autograph schedules, map, transportation and other "Know Before You Go" information, and the latest event updates via push notificationsConnect with the NFL's virtual assistant to ask questions and get information via "Ask Vince"Enter for a chance to win prizes, including a trip to Super Bowl LX in the Bay Area!How do I win prizes?In the app, you will find in the navigation bar "My NFL." Click on "My NFL" to view a list of badge locations where you can check in with your NFL OnePass. Once you have checked in at a badge location, the badge will "light up" (i.e. appear in color versus black and white).How do I use a Fanscan?In order to use the Fanscan feature, fans must have the NFL OnePass app downloaded and be registered for NFL Draft. To access Fanscan in the NFL OnePass app, click REWARDS in the bottom navigation bar, then click the Fanscan tile. Upon initial launch of Fanscan, fans will be prompted to allow Camera permissions and need to click Allow in order to use this feature. Fans can use Fanscan at the event to scan QR codes on signs placed at various attractions to unlock badges and be entered for a chance to win prizes.The more badges you earn, the more prizes you qualify to win. Prizes are not guaranteed to all fans. You will be notified via text message or email if you have won so be sure to enter your correct information when you register.Please visit NFL.com/OnePass for official rules. You must be over 18 to be eligible to win.What happens if I register for NFL OnePass via **NFL.com/draftaccess** before I download NFL OnePass app?Once you've downloaded the app, you will be directed to a screen with a "login" button. Please click on the button and login with your NFL.com account. Your NFL OnePass will appear in the app on the top right corner for easy access.Who can I contact if I have an issue with the NFL OnePass app?Please email OnePass@nfl.com for any issues or locate a guest services booth on-site at an NFL event.What is the age requirement for NFL OnePass registration?You must be over the age of 18 to register for NFL OnePass. Fans registering will be required to accept the waiver to complete their registration and participate in interactive games. During registration, adults will have the opportunity to add up to 5 minors. If you forget to add a minor during registration, you do not need to re-register. Your QR code will be scanned multiple times based on the number of minors (up to five) participating in the activity.What happens if I enter incorrect information during registration?If you entered incorrect information during registration, you will have the ability to edit your mobile phone number in the app. Navigate to the "More" section and click on "Edit Profile". Please note at this time, no other additional information can be updated.What happens if I forget to enter the minors attached to my NFL OnePass during registration?You do not need to re-register. Your NFL OnePass QR code will be scanned multiple times based on the number of minors participating at that activity.Will minors have their own NFL OnePass?No. Only adults over the age of 18 will have an NFL OnePass QR code. Each adult must have their own QR code.What if I do not have a smart phone?You may register for NFL OnePass on your desktop or onsite at the NFL OnePass Fan Services location. To register on your desktop, please visit nfl.com/draftaccess. If you register on-site at an event, you will receive a business-size card with your QR code. For all other methods of registration, fans will receive their NFL OnePass via email.Fans may also write down the code they receive upon registration to present as proof of registration on-site.Security ProtocolsHow will you create a safe environment?The NFL is committed to maintaining a safe environment for all attendees at the 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light. Security screening in and around NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express will be significantly heightened at each entrance. All items carried by fans will be carefully inspected and potentially prohibited from entry into the NFL Draft Experience and Draft Theater. The number of guests entering and leaving the premises will be closely monitored for the safety of our fans.Are cameras and video cameras allowed into the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?Small cameras and binoculars will be permitted. Professional grade camera and recording equipment will only be permitted for credentialed media. If you are a member of the media, contact Paula Ngon (paula.ngon@nfl.com) to coordinate access.Is there a clear bag policy at Draft Experience?Yes. All fans will go through airport level screening for entry and must adhere to our prohibited items list found HERE. The NFL Clear Bag Policy will be in effect for the NFL Draft. Fans are also required to register for NFL OnePass at NFL.com/draftaccess beginning March 4.FAMILY FAQDo NFL Draft fan events have private nursing rooms or changing tables?Yes. All Fan Services locations at NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express are accessible and equipped with baby changing tables and private space for nursing mothers.Can I bring my stroller and diaper bag to NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?Yes, strollers are allowed, subject to screening. There is a special security check for medically necessary items.Are pets allowed at the NFL events?Yes, service animals (dogs, and in some cases, miniature horses trained to perform work/do tasks for a fan because of a disability) and service animals in training are permitted into the Draft venues and may accompany fans with a disability in all public areas of Draft events (where other fans are permitted). However, other animals, including household pets and emotional support animals will not be admitted.ACCESSIBILITY INFORMATIONIs there an accessible entrance to NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express?All entrances at the NFL Draft presented by Bud Light are accessible. If you require additional Mobility Assistance, please proceed to a Fan Services booth. Mobility Assistance Teammates will be available to issue wheelchairs to attendees who request them. For accessibility and guest information locations, check out our event site maps.For all mobility related inquiries, please contact: nfldraftmobility@gmail.com.Accessible Viewing AreasThe NFL Draft Theater will be located in the lot in front of the existing Steelers Pro Shop at Art Rooney Ave. It is free and open to the public. Accessible viewing platforms will be available for fans using mobility devices and with other needs relating to their disabilities and their companions at multiple locations throughout the public viewing area.Video CaptioningAs a service to our guests who are deaf or hard of hearing, throughout the NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express site there will be caption enabled video screens. Within the Draft Theater, there will close captioning as well as a section dedicated to those who are hard of hearing, with an ASL sign language interpreter standing by. Additionally, information will be provided for fans on site to view closed captioning from their personal phone through a secure website.The NFL Draft presented by Bud Light is a fully accessible event and there will be closed captioning provided on multiple viewing screens, as well as a mobile device solution to deliver the closed captioning to a website that fans can access on their phones.Fans with Mobility DisabilitiesThe 2026 NFL Draft presented by Bud Light is accessible for fans using mobility devices. Notwithstanding, please note that: (i) it is a large venue with great distances between activities and attractions; (ii) it is outdoors and situated in parking lots and across city streets and pathways; and (iii)some travel is over natural terrain and terrain designed for motor vehicles (therefore, if it should rain, there could be mud).Wheelchairs, power wheelchairs, and three or four-wheeled scooters are allowed only for use by fans with mobility disabilities. For safety reasons, requests to use of other power-driven, mobility devices will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis. Powered wheelchairs may also be charged at an Accessibility Center/Fan Services Center. Fans should bring all cords and accessories needed to charge their devices. Chargers must use a 110-volt, 20-amp circuit.Accessible portable toilets are available at the ends of each bank of portable toilets throughout the venue within NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express and are available at each restroom location for the Draft Theater.Special Dietary NeedsOutside food and drink is not allowed inside the NFL Draft event, unless a fan has special medical dietary restriction.NFL Draft Experience presented by American Express will have food vendors that provide special dietary options. Please visit an Accessibility/Fan Services Center for a full list of menu options and further information.Other Medical Devices/Equipment/MedicationA fan requiring insulin or an EPI pen can bring his or her medically necessary materials and medications provided all medicine has a prescription label with the fans name. Out of concern for the festival staff and volunteers who handle the trash, fans should dispose of medical waste and syringes in the proper disposal located at the medical tent (see First Aid section and check out the First Aid locations on our event site maps. Guests should not dispose of these items in other trash bins at the festival.Service AnimalsService animals (dogs, and in some cases, miniature horses trained to perform work/do tasks for a fan because of a disability) and service animals in training are permitted into the Draft venues and may accompany fans with a disability in all public areas of Draft events (where other fans are permitted). However, other animals, including household pets and emotional support animals will not be admitted.Pittsburgh TravelHow can I get to the 2026 NFL Draft?Information on parking and transportation will be available by April 1, 2026.
